slug: 2025-01-01 Role of ESCCOM as National Data Protection Agency

facts.fact: ESCCOM's mandate page states the Data Protection Act designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Data Protection Agency (section 5), with power to investigate breaches, resolve complaints and impose administrative fines; the page is undated, so its published year 2025 is used.
